product_one_liner.value: Disprz provides an AI-powered learning and skilling platform—including LMS, LXP, content creation, coaching, and analytics—to help enterprises develop workforce capabilities across knowledge and frontline teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage describes its platform and enterprise workforce audience.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists an Essentials plan starting at $2 per learner per month and an Enterprise plan with custom pricing.

named_customers.notes: Disprz's company profile explicitly identifies these organizations as customers.

hq_location.notes: Disprz contact page labels its West Orange, New Jersey address “North America HQ”; LinkedIn also lists West Orange, New Jersey as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn company profile gives 2015 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is predominantly learning-industry, product, and marketing content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center FAQ contains 98 answers in multiple categories, providing a collection of product/help articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page has no current open role listings; it only provides a “Browse all jobs” link.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public AI-related FAQ and GenAI blog content; these discuss AI capabilities and give examples such as GPT-4 but do not state which model or provider Disprz uses in its product.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust-vault search listing names ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II attestation; Disprz also published a SOC 2 certification announcement.

last_funding.notes: Disprz announced a $30 million Series C round in August 2023; this is the latest publicly identified round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was announced in August 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No current role listings are displayed on the careers page.

launched_6mo.notes: Disprz announced the Autonomous Enablement OS launch on 2026-09-28, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company page presents its leadership roster, and no C-level/VP join or departure within the period was identified in the reviewed public announcements.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed product pricing and FAQ pages mention integrations generally but do not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system as part of Disprz's visible stack; a company-authored comparison article mentions Salesforce and HubSpot only as general market examples, not as Disprz systems.
